results.explanation: At the declared entry, the verified-user dependency is used and a non-admin file lookup is constrained by both the supplied file ID and user.id, so source-file ownership/visibility is checked. That check is not a destination-collection authorization check. When embedding/retrieval is not bypassed, process_file constructs docs from the file content and calls save_docs_to_vector_db with the caller-supplied collection_name and add=True; this is the visible destination write sink. The supplied source shows no check that the caller owns the destination collection or has an explicit write grant before that call. However, the supplied source also makes reaching that sink conditional on BYPASS_EMBEDDING_AND_RETRIEVAL being false; the premise does not establish that configuration value. Therefore the source establishes an unauthorized destination-write path when the bypass is false, but does not establish that the write effect is reachable for the fixed scenario without that missing configuration observation. Source-file ownership is distinct from destination write permission and does not satisfy the accepted policy.
